en-US.longDescription:
What if you woke up one day to find that you lost precious photos of dear ones? How about losing your business documents, research and other important data?
Shivering thoughts, with a simple solution: Backup4all.
Backup4all is a powerful backup software used by NASA on the ISS that can be used to back-up your personal or business data into the cloud.
en-US.name: Backup4all 9

zh-CN.longDescription:
如果某天醒来，发现珍贵亲友的照片全部消失？或是丢失了商业文件、研究资料等重要数据？
这些念头令人不寒而栗，但解决方法其实很简单：Backup4all。
Backup4all 是一款功能强大的备份软件，甚至被 NASA 用于国际空间站（ISS），它能将您的个人或商业数据安全备份至云端。
